course: 示例课程（公开测试标题）
workflow: This JSON is an agent/operator checklist, NOT a CLI config file or unattended batch runner.
Open an already-authorized course document yourself in the owned authenticated session. Do not handle login/captcha with this utility.

Validate the returned course, full visible catalog, exact zero-based target indices and exact titles against targets. Reject exams, missing targets, ambiguous catalog or unknown authorization. Hidden/unloaded catalog entries are not enumerated.
Record earliest unfinished non-exam authorized chapter from progress values below 100. Missing progress or uncertain authorization requires human review; do not guess. The CLI never clicks chapters.

If permitted to change UI, the operator/agent opens each configured target using normal authorized UI, then probes again. Download only when exact course/index/title matches and there is one explicit Photo PDF viewer.

Run per target: python3 scripts/extract_course.py --download --session owned-session-name --expect-course '示例课程（公开测试标题）' --chapter-index 0 --chapter-title '第一章：示例文档' --output-dir ./authorized-course-pdfs

Repeat with the next exact configured index/title. Record each returned safe manifest. Do not treat skipped chapters, HTML responses, page mismatches or canvas-only sources as successful full extraction.

In the agent/operator finally step, restore the recorded earliest unfinished authorized chapter through normal UI if UI changes were enabled, then probe to verify exact course/index/title. Report restoration failure separately; do not claim completion.
Without UI-change permission, extract only the already-open matching target. This utility cannot batch unopened documents or restore a chapter on its own.
CORS, denied access, unsupported document source or download restrictions: stop and use the site's official Download control if available. Never disable browser security or replay cookies.
publication_warning: Only share scripts, tests and this synthetic example. Never publish PDFs, manifests with real titles, browser profiles, signed URLs or credentials.
